---
name: Roadmap task
about: Claim and implement a scoped roadmap item
---
## Roadmap ID and priority
E.g. CORE-09 / P1. Existing platform optimization only; no new features.

## Owner and dependencies
Assign yourself; list linked blockers and code areas.

## User outcome and scope
Describe what changes and what is explicitly deferred.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Concrete behavior and scenario
- [ ] Failure/negative/cancellation cases
- [ ] Reproducible evidence and known limits

## Verification plan
Use fictional fixtures. State if tests touch audio devices, restart apps, require network/provider access or must run with no call active.

## Baseline and candidate evidence
Record revision, hardware/OS/model, scenario, sample count, all outcomes, processing versus deliberate hold, quality guards and rollback. Link the source finding from docs/ARCHITECTURE-REVIEW.md.
